name: wri-map-guard
label: WRI Map Guard
author: Whitewater Rescue Institute
description: Invisible map companion for phones. (1) If the map's WebGL context is lost and ExB's own recovery has not brought it back within 8 s, shows a one-tap 'restore' button that reloads onto the same page. (2) Optionally (releaseOnHide) destroys the MapView that ExB parks in memory when a reference-map page is hidden, so only the current map holds a WebGL context; the next visit rebuilds the map fresh.
